id.description: Unique identifier for the job position

displayName.description: Human-readable name for the job position
displayName.example: Software Engineer I, Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Manager

isActive.description: Is this position currently active and accepting applications?

basicInfo.description: basic information relating to the position

positionOpenDate.description: The date the position is supposed to open.

positionEndDate.description: The date the position is supposed to close. If no end date is selected, enter 0

positionSalaryType.description: What is the salary type of the position

startingSalary.description: What is the lowest salary offered for this position. For hourly positions, post the per-hour compensation. For salary positions, post the yearly compensation.

endingSalary.description: What is the highest salary offered for this position. For hourly positions, post the per-hour compensation. For salary positions, post the yearly compensation.

positionCity.description: Where is the position located? For remote positions, enter 'Remote'. For hybrid positions, enter the primary location (e.g., 'New York, NY').

positionState.description: What state is the position being offered in? For remote positions, state where the company is headquartered.

positionType.description: What is the type of position offered?

department.description: What department is this position in? This can be used for internal categorization and filtering but is not required to be displayed on the front-end.

description.description: A detailed description of the job position, including responsibilities, qualifications, and any other relevant information.

items.description: A single item in the job description. This can be a paragraph, list-bulleted, or list-numbered item.

content.description: The content of the description item. For 'paragraph' type, this should be a single string. For 'list' type, this should be a string with items separated by newlines.

example.content: We are seeking a skilled CAD Technician to join our team. The ideal candidate will have experience in creating detailed technical drawings and plans using computer-aided design (CAD) software. The CAD Technician will work closely with engineers and architects to produce accurate and high-quality designs for various projects.

Responsibilities include interpreting technical drawings, creating 3D models, and collaborating with project teams to ensure designs meet specifications. The successful candidate will have strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

benefits.description: A list of benefits offered for this position.

items.description: A single benefit offered for this position.

requirements.description: A list of requirements for this position.

items.description: A single requirement for this position.

example: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
3+ years of experience in software development

meta.description: Additional metadata about the job position that is used in back-end systems but not displayed on the front-end. This can include information such as internal notes, tags for categorization, or any other relevant data that should not be exposed to the public.

tags.description: Internal tags for categorizing the job position.

items.description: A single tag for categorizing the job position.

submissionType.description: The type of submission for this position. This can be used to determine how applications are processed (e.g., through an ATS, via email, etc.).

submissionSettings.description: Settings used for the selected submission type.

requireResumeUpload.description: Indicates whether applicants are required to upload a resume when applying for this position.

requireCoverLetter.description: Indicates whether applicants are required to upload a cover letter when applying for this position.

submissionSettings.description: Settings for email submissions, if applicable.

recipientEmail.description: The email address to which applications should be sent.

submissionSettings.description: Settings for ATS submissions, if applicable.

atsUrl.description: The URL of the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) where applications should be submitted.
